title: Affine differential sections with the universal derivation formula
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset S$ be affine opens with $U\subset f^{-1}V$. Set $A=\Gamma(X,U)$ and $R=\Gamma(S,V)$, with the ring map induced by $f$. There is an $A$-linear equivalence $e:\Omega_{A/R}\to\Gamma(U,\Omega_{X/S})$ [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] satisfying $e(\mathrm da)=\mathrm d_{X/S}a$ for every $a\in A$.

proof.text: Obtain the linear map compatible with the universal derivation from the affine calculation.
The affine calculation proves that any such compatible map is bijective. Convert the bijective linear map to a linear equivalence and retain its derivation formula.
